c_status.0: accepted operation; inspect/normal plan/semantic panic distinguished in output header
c_status.4294967293: strict input is not valid UTF-8 at one of the two string boundaries
c_status.4294967294: short required header or insufficient preflight output/workspace capacity
c_status.4294967295: invalid operation/policy/reserved field/frame extent or unrepresentable native sizing

semantic_codes.1: original context*2 checked overflow; operands=context,2; panic payload: attempt to multiply with overflow
semantic_codes.2: original u32 distinct-ID increment checked overflow; operands=4294967295,1; panic payload: attempt to add with overflow; source-derived and not exercised at this impractical input scale
semantic_codes.3: original formatter indexed beyond a line array; operands=line_count,index; preserve first failing traversal position and bounds panic payload
semantic_codes.4: original checked coordinate addition overflow; exact source category is selected per defining non-generic versus monomorphized arithmetic; only full-source reachable branches belong to the owner contract
semantic_codes.5: original checked coordinate subtraction overflow; same category provenance requirements as semantic code 4
semantic_codes.6: rendered String capacity overflow; allocation failure/OOM is not promised to be bit-identical

transport_precedence: operation/policy/reserved validation and exact source/descriptor framing -> INVALID
strict validation of complete UTF-8 source and old/new split boundary -> INVALID_UTF8
native line count and all sizing arithmetic checks -> INVALID
plan output and workspace upper-bound capacity checks -> SHORT
only now may scratch stores begin and algorithmic/semantic outcomes be computed

write_contract.nonzero_c: Every byte of output and workspace remains unchanged; source is always unchanged
write_contract.inspect_c_zero: Only output[0:128] changes; source, workspace, and output tail remain unchanged
write_contract.plan_c_zero_normal: Descriptor workspace[0:64] unchanged; scratch[64:required_workspace_capacity] may change; output[0:plan_bytes] contains the result, output tail and scratch tail after advertised capacity unchanged
write_contract.plan_c_zero_semantic: Only output[0:128] is published, no partial String result; scratch within advertised capacity may change; header reports the original semantic failure

reference.algorithm: Myers -> Compact -> Replace -> group_diff_ops -> UnifiedDiff formatter
reference.scope: Two exported unified_diff_from_chunks APIs plus internal with_mode consumer; FS reads/PathUri/chunk computation remain existing boundaries

memory_preconditions: All declared byte ranges are live and readable/writable according to their role for the duration of the call
source, output and workspace do not overlap
unaligned byte pointers are supported by buffer primitives
source is old_bytes immediately followed by new_bytes; the adapter performs only this transport copy

arithmetic_policy.0: non-generic defining arithmetic checked; monomorphized-owner arithmetic checked
arithmetic_policy.1: non-generic defining arithmetic wrapping; monomorphized-owner arithmetic wrapping
arithmetic_policy.2: non-generic defining arithmetic checked; monomorphized-owner arithmetic wrapping
arithmetic_policy.3: non-generic defining arithmetic wrapping; monomorphized-owner arithmetic checked

input.context_range: 0..18446744073709551615, with no clamp or blanket rejection
input.source_extent: old_bytes <= source.len and new_bytes == source.len-old_bytes; subtraction validation avoids header addition overflow
input.plan_workspace: at least required_workspace_capacity bytes; the first 64 descriptor bytes remain unchanged
input.strict_utf8: both old and new are valid UTF-8 separately; whole source validation plus old_bytes scalar boundary is equivalent
input.trusted_precondition: both halves come from valid Rust &str; trusted operations skip only UTF-8 admission, not tokenization, arithmetic policy, or native computation
input.strict_trusted_equivalence: For all valid UTF-8 input halves, identical headers, plans, bytes and semantic panic classification under the same arithmetic policy
input.unknown_policy: Every value >=4 is INVALID before UTF-8 admission or writes.

arithmetic_category_map.source_domains: The two enum bits denote defining similar compilation and actual monomorphizing apply-patch owner compilation; neither is inferred from outer executable flags.
arithmetic_category_map.context_radius_times_two: Observed original group context multiplication checks under defining bit: policies 0/2.
arithmetic_category_map.IdentifyDistinct_u32_primitive_Add: Actual u32 Add IR follows owner bit: policies 0/3; billion-line boundary is source/IR-derived, not executed.
arithmetic_category_map.generic_concrete_usize_arithmetic: Observed conquer/find_middle_snake, Compact and Replace concrete add/sub checks use conjunction: policy 0 only. Valid-source bounds make most internal values independent of arithmetic mode.
arithmetic_category_map.nongeneric_copies: Source syntax does not determine all compiled call sites. Actual owner IR contains internal max_d/as_tag_tuple copies with different overflow lowering. Admitted S bounds must prove relevant operations cannot overflow.
arithmetic_category_map.abs: find_middle_snake core isize::abs may retain owner-controlled neg overflow in policy 3; native coordinate proof must show its operand cannot reach isize::MIN.
arithmetic_category_map.public_wrapping_groups: A wrapping context can create an invalid source span; preserve semantic bounds failure order, not source-range validation rejection.
arithmetic_category_map.debug_assertions: Separate codegen dimension. Actual Replace active-coordinate invariant is proven for full Myers/Compact event streams; no debug flag inferred from overflow.
arithmetic_category_map.production_policy_admission: Raw operations accept explicit policies 0..3. Production must supply a policy admitted against its actual compiler and artifact provenance. A deployment may support a narrower evidence-bound set; unsupported build configurations must fail admission rather than choose a guessed policy.

output.query_header: All actual-plan/result fields are zero; line counts and both required capacities are native-computed; semantic_code is 0 because query does not run the diff algorithm
output.successful_plan: fragment_table_offset=128; literal_pool_offset=128+32*fragment_count; plan_bytes=literal_pool_offset+literal_pool_bytes; rendered_bytes equals the checked sum of emitted fragment lengths
output.native_formatting: HIA constructs every header digit, prefix, separator and missing-newline marker; Rust only validates the plan and copies the named byte ranges
output.semantic_plan: C status 0, plan_bytes=128, rendered_bytes=fragment_count=fragment_table_offset=literal_pool_offset=literal_pool_bytes=0; semantic_code/operands populated; only output[0:128] written; scratch within advertised capacity may have changed

sizing.status: Normative revision-2 capacities: inspect reports the stated conservative bounds and plan requires both bounds before any scratch store. This specifies ABI obligations rather than qualification results.
sizing.group_bound: at most S+1 groups and 2*S+2 grouped operation rows
sizing.emitted_line_bound: at most 2*S for successful rendering: compaction preserves the original line stream; each Equal run is kept at most twice by grouping; an out-of-range wrapped group becomes a semantic bounds panic before expansion
sizing.fragment_bound: 8*S+8, covering at most 3 fragments per emitted line plus one per group
sizing.literal_bound: 96*S+128, covering at most 92 bytes per u64 hunk header plus the 3 prefix bytes and one shared 29-byte missing-newline literal
sizing.workspace_bound_derivation: 64 descriptor + 256 bookkeeping + 16*S line spans + 8*S IDs + max(8*T,16*(S+3)+48*(2*S+4)+56*(2*S+4),40*(S+2)+48*(2*S+4)), where hash capacity T<=4*S+2; this is <=1024+256*S

arenas.line_spans: 16*S bytes, old then new; terminators included
arenas.ids: 8*S bytes carrying actual u32 IDs when interning is selected
arenas.hash: 8*T bytes, T the first power of two >= max(2,2*S); exact byte collision resolution; may reuse subsequent algorithm arena
arenas.frontiers: Two arrays of 2*D i64 slots, D=(S+1)/2+1; exact total32*D bytes. This is at most16*(S+3), and signed k coordinates are within admitted S.
arenas.tasks: 2*S+4 entries of 48 bytes for explicit left-before-right conquest/suffix continuations
arenas.compact_nodes: 2*S+4 nodes of 56 bytes; preserve original pointer traversal, coordinate updates and deletion quirks; recycle removed nodes
arenas.replace_rows: S+2 entries of 40 bytes, reuse expired frontier/task memory
arenas.group_rows: 2*S+4 entries of 48 bytes, reuse compact node memory after replacement

proofs_required: Every checked add/multiply used in sizing is guarded before stores
Myers raw nonempty event weight is <=S
Compact transfers equal-run lengths and preserves positive event weight; at most one transient extra node, with removed nodes recycled
Explicit task stack bound covers suffix continuations as well as left/right ranges
Retained grouped rows and successful emitted line/fragment counts satisfy the above bounds, including wrapping context branches
All arena intervals and live-range reuse are independently reviewed and tested
sizing.capacity_policy: plan requires the full advertised upper bounds even when a smaller buffer could contain this particular result; accepting smaller capacities is explicitly outside revision 2
sizing.resource_note: No fixed 1 MiB input cap. Conservative O(S) native arenas and host transport copies may exceed original allocation costs. Allocation failure and OOM are not promised to be identical.

semantics.tokenize: LF, CR, CRLF delimit; retain exact terminator; no extra token after a final terminator; CRLF does not cross the old/new source boundary; NEL/LS/PS/NUL are ordinary content
semantics.intern: Only when either side exceeds 100 tokens. Assign u32 identities in old-first then new-first-seen order. Exact byte equality resolves every internal hash collision and preserves original wrapped identity behavior. The hash function and bucket placement are private implementation choices; they do not change identity assignment or output semantics.
semantics.myers: Same prefix/suffix trimming, descending k order, tie choice, odd/even overlap return coordinates, left-before-right recursion and final suffix order as pinned upstream; no alternative shortest edit script
semantics.compact: Delete pass then insert pass, shift up then down, exactly matching original swaps/merges and range-mutator definitions; do not substitute a corrected or standard cleanup algorithm
semantics.coordinates: No cross-op monotonicity invariant and no reconstruction of coordinates from rendered line counts; actual Compact can leave stale indices affecting header text
semantics.grouping: First/last Equal trimming occurs before loop; context*2 is evaluated only for each Equal including a zero-length one; wrapping uses u64 modulo and can produce oversized Equal spans
semantics.formatting: Header start from first op, end from last op, saturating range lengths; default context 1 in Codex; no filename headers; Replace emits all deletes then all inserts; exact CR/CRLF bytes and missing-newline markers The actual iterator must yield a valid first change before its group header is formatted; a group with no yielded changes emits no header. Range start+1 is evaluated even for zero-length headers before subtracting one, preserving branch order.
semantics.equality_fast_path: Forbidden unless implemented wholly in HIA and proven to preserve interning, Equal grouping and arithmetic failures; old==new is not sufficient to return an empty string

permitted: Encode lengths, context and admitted build-time arithmetic policy
Call strict/trusted HIA query then HIA plan
Validate C status, header, row bounds, reserved words, UTF-8 slices and aggregate output byte count
Allocate one String and copy native-selected source/literal fragments in native order
Raise the equivalent Rust panic for a native semantic panic record; panic=abort/unwind follows the host build
prohibited: Rust line splitting, line identity assignment, LCS/Myers, compaction, grouping, header arithmetic/formatting or hidden fallback
Passing reference-generated DiffOps into the production native interface
Using source equality to skip HIA
Clamping context or replacing overflow behavior with a blanket INVALID
Calling the old similar implementation from the native production branch

provenance.preserve: Source attribution and complete upstream license must accompany a production adaptation; the HIA grammar has no comment form, so use a sidecar attribution file.
